body.p: The Crow. The crow went to visit the seagull. He harnessed three white deer. He put deers to the gull tent, entered the tent. The daughter of the seagull said: "Sit down here, help yourself." The rest of the seagulls silently went outside. The seagull girl put a bowl of meat and a bottle of vodka in front of the crow. The crow ate, drank three cups. His face flushed, he stretched out his hand with joy, said: "Cousin, let me kiss your nose." Then the daughter of the seagull, having struck him on the chest, pushed him away, gathering her fingers into a fist, and pushed him out into the street. She just said: "Stay away, your mouth stinks, stay away." Then the crow quickly went outside. It jumped outside. It looked: at the door only the veins of deer remained. It went home on foot. He came home and said: âWife, the daughter of a seagull, is evil, it turns out. She poked my chest with a bent finger. His wife doesn't even look at him. So she said: âLooks like it wasnât in vain that I hit you.â The moral among the Nenets is this: if you have a wife, don't pester the girls.
